I would stay completely out of the zoning issue itself. TLC should not be interpreting zoning regulations, contacting municipalities on their behalf, or giving legal/compliance advice. Instead, position yourself as helping them identify the right professional and next steps.

You could respond with something like:

:::writing{variant="chat_message" id="58214"}
Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

Unfortunately, zoning and municipal compliance matters fall outside the scope of the services we provide at The Luxora Collective, so we would not be the appropriate party to interpret local zoning regulations or communicate with the township on your behalf.

That said, I would recommend the following steps:

1. Continue documenting all communication attempts with the township, including emails, phone calls, dates, and times.
2. Contact the Medford Township Planning & Zoning Department directly and request written confirmation of the property's current zoning designation and permitted uses.
3. If you are unable to obtain a response, consider engaging a local zoning attorney, land-use attorney, or commercial real estate professional familiar with Medford Township regulations. They can often obtain answers more quickly and guide you through any variance, permitting, or compliance requirements that may be necessary.
4. Review any existing lease documents, certificates of occupancy, business licenses, or prior permitting records, as these may provide helpful information regarding the property's approved use.

While we are happy to support the growth and operational side of your practice, we want to ensure you receive guidance from the appropriate zoning and legal professionals on this matter.

Please keep us updated on what you learn, and we will continue supporting you in the areas where we can add the most value.
:::

Internally, I would also tell Aanchal not to start calling the township. Once TLC steps into that role, you risk being viewed as providing compliance guidance. The safest lane is: *"Here's who can help, here's the process, and here's what we'd recommend you ask for in writing."*

:::writing{variant="chat_message" id="48172"}
Hi,

Unfortunately, zoning and compliance matters fall outside of our area of expertise at The Luxora Collective, so we're not the best resource to advise on this situation.

We would recommend working directly with the township or consulting a local zoning attorney or commercial real estate professional who can provide guidance specific to your property and local regulations.

Please keep us updated on the outcome, and we'll continue supporting you with the growth and operational side of the practice.
:::

This keeps you completely out of the compliance conversation and doesn't imply you're taking ownership of solving it.
Make the response shorter and less steps because that is putting us in that role

We do not deal with this type of thing at TLC, but what dltype of response and advice can I give that will point her in the right direction and still make sure we stay in our own lane: Thank you. I need your assistance with a zoning issue we are currently facing at our Medford location.
When the medspa originally opened, the proper zoning review and inspection process was unfortunately not completed. We are now attempting to address this and become fully compliant, but we have been unable to get clear guidance from the township regarding the property’s zoning status.
I have made several attempts to contact the individual responsible for zoning in Medford through both email and phone calls:
Ann Bell 609-654-2608 ext. 324 abell@medfordtownship.com
Unfortunately, I have not yet received a response.
We are trying to determine whether the Medford location is properly zoned for medical and aesthetic services. If it is not, we would like to understand what steps are required to correct the situation as quickly as possible.
Would you be able to assist by reaching out or helping us obtain answers on this matter today? Any guidance or assistance would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you for your help. @Aanchal Somera @Bethany
